**Kubernetes and platform.** Twenty-plus microservices on a six-node cluster.
ArgoCD and Flux for GitOps, Helm, progressive delivery, rollback by commit SHA.
CKA certified.

**Cloud and infrastructure as code.** Terraform and Ansible across four clouds.
ECS and EKS estates, LKE, VPC design, sixty-second auto-deploy. Client spend down
25 to 35 percent through right-sizing.

**AI gateways and routing.** LiteLLM proxies and my own routers in front of GPT,
Claude, Gemini and open-weight models. Semantic caching, provider fallback,
per-tenant keys and spend control. One gateway has carried more than 100 billion
tokens for 200+ clients.

**Inference and model work.** Serving open models, quantization and the
requantization tax, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning runs, and refusal removal.
I take abliteration apart on text, vision and video models and publish the
numbers. The GLM-5.3-Flash teardown is 12,479 edited matrices of 76,108.

**Agents.** Tool-using agent workflows and the ecosystem around them: MCP
servers, long-running agent environments, benchmark and eval harnesses for agent
behaviour, AI-assisted deployment tooling.

**DevSecOps.** Secrets management, image and dependency scanning,
least-privilege IAM, CI/CD security review, Linux and Active Directory hardening,
vulnerability management.

**Security operations.** DFIR, incident response, threat hunting, YARA,
detection engineering. SOC analyst background. Bug bounty on production web apps
and APIs.

**Observability.** Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, alerting, runbooks, capacity
planning. MTTR down 40 percent on a client estate.
